# Benedict W. H. Dixon

> Personal site of Benedict W. H. Dixon. Building, leading & learning. Engineer turned operator: JPMorgan, Amex, a hedge fund, fintech, then co-founding companies. Co-founder, COO & Interim CTO at kash. Three of us built kash's whole product. Mine was the fat middle, from the hooks the frontend calls down to indexing on-chain events.

Key facts:
- Started out as an engineer, building payment systems at JPMorgan, then on the R&D team for Amex's referral campaigns. After that came a hedge fund, fintech, and founding his own startups.
- Made a very conscious and intentional move from writing code to running companies and teams. When AI tooling arrived, went back to building.
- A strategic, product and technology advisor to early-stage startups and founders. Always interested to compare notes with people doing the work.

## Key pages

- [Home / About](https://benedictdixon.com/): About, career, writing, contact.
- [How I work with AI](https://benedictdixon.com/ai/): The standing map of the AI practice — the work, the tooling, the personal stack, the view.
- [Writing](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/): His essays first, then a 24-part Disciplined Entrepreneurship series as a reference shelf.
- [For podcast hosts](https://benedictdixon.com/hosts/): Bio, photo, topics and past talks.

## The essays

- [AI collapsed the build, not the operation](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/ai-collapsed-the-build/): One person with AI can build what fifty used to; the operation doesn't collapse with it.
- [The unit of production has changed](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/the-unit-of-production-has-changed/): Three of us built kash, and mine is kind of the fat middle; AI deleted the coordination overhead.
- [The assistant that knows you](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/the-assistant-that-knows-you/): Point a personal AI at your second brain and it answers from your notes.
- [The assistant that's always on](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/always-on-assistant/): A personal AI assistant on your own machine, reachable where you already text.
- [Building a second brain that doesn't die](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/building-a-second-brain/): An Obsidian PKM template wired for Claude Code, open-sourced under MIT.
- [In Clawd We Trust](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/in-clawd-we-trust/): A year of intensive Claude Code, distilled into a practical guide.

- [Tesserakt Protocol](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/tesserakt-protocol/): Purpose-built infrastructure for AI agents.
- [The missing infrastructure for AI agents](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/the-missing-infrastructure-for-ai-agents/): Agents are forced through rails built for humans.
- [Autonomous AI agents](https://benedictdixon.com/writing/autonomous-ai-agents/): Agents representing individuals and businesses, executing in milliseconds.
